Mating context: modeled as numbered PCB pins P<k> to open mating contacts M<k> with Wurth's max contact resistance (same pattern as OHM-163/166). Harwin M20 (current reference) publishes no working voltage (prior round).
Mating counterpart/test condition behind the 20 mOhm max is not stated by Wurth.
No all-positions-loaded derating, Rth, bulk resistance or inductance sourced.
